'''Corman''' is one of the [[Aiel]] in [[Rhuidean]]. He is of the ''[[Far Aldazar Din]]'' society and of the [[Mosaada]] [[Goshien]].

== Appearance ==
He has a white scar across his nose.

== Activities ==
He plays a game of knives with [[Matrim Cauthon]] until he realizes how good Mat's luck is.{{ref/book|5|3}}

He later greets [[Rand al'Thor]] when Rand arrives in [[Cairhien]] for a visit.
